utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh lovely, Uli — if you’re heading over, we could still use a few hand tools, sturdy boxes, and any spare tarps folks can spare.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — I’ll bring whatever I can and keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s so kind of you, Uli — I’ll set those aside and make sure they get put to good use.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s at the community center on Saturday from 10 to 2, and you can bring broken small appliances or tools. If you want, I can also point you to the easiest entrance once you’re there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — could you share the easiest entrance and any nearby landmark? I want to pass the repair drive details along clearly.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — use the side entrance by the parking lot; it’s right next to the big maple tree. If you’re telling others, that landmark makes it easy to spot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll be ready at 10 tomorrow, and we can go through the fixes one by one.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — 10 tomorrow works for me, and I’ll be there to help sort donations and hand out screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Faye — see you at 10 tomorrow, and we’ll keep it simple and work through it one by one.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just checking — we’re still set for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — we’re still set for today. I’ll bring the hammer, screwdriver set, and any spare screws I have.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — I was thinking of contacting Opal and Ira first. I can keep it to just those two unless you want a wider list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes — as far as I know, we’re still set for today.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — I’ll just reach out to Opal and Ira for now, and keep you posted. Thanks for the quick check-in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll take a quick look and let you know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. Keep me posted, and I’ll make sure the updated Sunday community center details stay on the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll check it out and send you the update soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let’s start with the leaky faucet if it’s the messier one, and then move to the front-step rail.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, that sounds right — let’s tackle the leaky faucet first and keep the update simple and quiet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll note the faucet first and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I’ll be there at 10 and help sort donations and hand out screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, thanks, Faye — see you at 10, and I’ll have the donation table and screwdrivers ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good, Gus — see you then.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ve got it: this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center, and I’ll bring any broken small appliances or tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Glad it’s clear — and yes, please pass it along to anyone who might need it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll let people know so they can come by with broken small appliances or tools.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No problem, Dane — I’ve got the tape and screws set aside. See you there, even if you’re a bit late.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. I’ll swing by late, but I’ll bring what I can and help out when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll keep the tape and screws ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Noah — send over the first couple of things when you’ve sorted your notes, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — I’ll sort my notes and send the first couple of things to grab soon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — I’ll keep an eye out for your notes and jump on the first couple of things as soon as they come through.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep the shed on Maple Lane in mind and direct folks from Oak Street by the signs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and bring more neighbors over to help out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep that route handy in case anyone needs it again.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That should help—just send me the timing and what needs hauling, and I’ll see if I can make it work.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll send the 10am timing and the hauling list before then so you can decide. Thanks, Pia.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that’s perfect. I’ll look for your message and see if I can make it work.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can still help a little, Mina—just keep it low-key and tell me what’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — then let’s start with the leaky faucet since it sounds most urgent. If that goes quick, we can check the front-step rail next.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That works for me — I can help with the faucet quietly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Vik — 10 tomorrow works for me. Send the fixes over and we’ll go through them one by one.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — I’ll keep it simple and send over the fixes and hauling list before 10 tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Vik — I’ll be ready at 10 tomorrow and we can go through everything one by one.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — that should help. I’ll check the hall sign and report back if they still need tape or screws.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll keep the tape and screws ready in case they’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll check the hall sign and let you know if they still need tape or screws.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll check in with a few neighbors today and send you anything they need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate it. I’ve updated the drive to Sunday at the community center, so just send me any repair or supply needs you hear about.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, Rosa — I’ll let neighbors know it’s Sunday at the community center and send you any repair or supply needs I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the faucet first — I’ll keep it low-key and send the basics and timing soon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — just send me the timing and what needs hauling, and I’ll see if I can make it work.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do — I’ll send the timing and a short list of what needs hauling soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out and pass along any tools, supplies, or neighbors who need repairs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Sam — I’ll let you know the latest list of what’s still needed, and you can bring anything you find right over.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Tess — send me the updated list and I’ll keep an eye out for anything folks can spare.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — I’m bringing the hammer, screwdriver set, and spare screws today.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Leo — thanks for bringing those today. I’ll have everything set up when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll see you soon — I’ll bring the tools and screws over today.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rey — I’ll keep spreading the word so we can get as many neighbors as possible to stop by and help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course, Quinn — I’ll check in with a few neighbors and see who still needs repairs or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate it. I’ll keep inviting folks, and together we’ll make sure everyone hears about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Hana — I’ll keep my toolbox ready and set aside whatever you need once you send the list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’ll double-check the list and send over exactly what tools we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Hana — I’ll be ready when your list comes in and I’ll pull together the tools right away.
